literal output uses ldrb/strb loops and length-distance output copies

interpretation: MX490 4.040 uses standard zlib inflate for the four embedded payloads; the known related-model proprietary LZ signature is not required for these streams.
caveat: This identifies a decompression runtime, not the caller, destination addresses, signature verification, or a flashable custom-firmware path.
